decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on the 29th November 2004, the erection of a single-storey rear extension to measure 4.2m deep by 5.82m wide by 2.75m maximum height with a flat roof, and the erection of a detached outbuilding at the end of the rear garden to measure 7m wide by 7m deep by 2.7m maximum height with a flat roof, is lawful within the meaning of section 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

Condition : 2 - Informative: The detached outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse known as 33 Spring Grove Road and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or separate habitable unit and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse and the erection of a detached building in rear end of garden to dwellinghouse for use as a leisure room.
